Landing.title: All your contacts, together and organized
Landing.subtitle: Your contacts and their details live in your account, not on your phone, so they're there on any device
Landing.featuresSubtitle: Simple for every day, complete for when your contacts add up

tags.title: Organized with tags
tags.text: Group contacts with tags like Family, Friends and Colleagues, or colour tags of your own, and view each group on its own.

search.title: Fast search
search.text: Find anyone in seconds by part of a name or number, and the list stays in alphabetical order however long it gets.

duplicates.title: No duplicate contacts
duplicates.text: The same number in any format, like 0912 and +98912, and matching names are found so you can merge or ignore them. Saving a number you already have gets a heads-up too.

birthday.title: Birthdays, photos and notes
birthday.text: Keep a photo, a birthday and a note about what matters next to each number, so it's all at hand when you need it.

actions.title: One tap to reach them
actions.text: Call or text straight from your book, and send any contact to someone with a link.

preferences.title: Your way
preferences.text: Persian or English, light or dark, in one of three colour themes — whichever suits you.

Landing.securitySubtitle: Your contacts are personal, so you should stay in control of them.

private.title: Only for you
private.text: Each account can reach only its own contacts. A link you send shows just the name, number and photo, never the birthday or note.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.text: Turn it on with an authenticator app so signing in needs a six-digit code as well as your password, with recovery codes for when your phone isn't at hand.

sessions.title: Sign out of devices
sessions.text: See in Settings which devices are signed in to your account, and sign out of any one of them or all at once.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.text: Delete your account whenever you like by confirming your password; all your contacts, photos and data are erased for good.

what.q: What is Contacts, and who is it for?
what.a: A personal online phonebook for anyone with lots of contacts who wants finding them and keeping them in order to be easy, whether they're friends and family or colleagues.

add.a: After signing up, use “New contact”. A name and number are enough; a photo, birthday, note and tags are optional. You can edit any contact later, and a deleted one stays in the trash for 7 days in case you want it back.

import.q: Are my phone's contacts imported automatically?
import.a: No. For now you add contacts yourself; Contacts can't read your phone's contact list and doesn't sync with it.

devices.q: Does it work on my phone and computer?
devices.a: Yes, with nothing to install: sign in from the browser on any phone, tablet or computer, and your contacts are there on a new phone too. You can also install it like an app; on a device you've signed in on, it works offline and your changes are saved once you confirm them.

twoFactor.a: No. You can skip it when you sign up and turn it on from Settings at any time. We recommend turning it on.

birthday.a: Birthdays use the Persian (Jalali) calendar in the Persian version and the Gregorian calendar in the English version.

Landing.aboutText1: Contacts was built with one simple aim: to make keeping in touch with the people in your life tidier and easier. Their numbers, birthdays and the things you don't want to forget, all in one place and always within reach.
Landing.aboutText2: It was designed for Persian speakers from the start, with the Jalali calendar and Iranian phone numbers, and it comes in English too. Over time it's meant to grow into a fuller tool for managing your personal connections.
